Functions $f$ and $h$ are graphed.

![Function f is graphed. The x-axis goes from negative 4 to 4. The graph consists of a set of line segments. The set starts at (negative 4, negative 1), moves horizontally to the right to (negative 2, negative 1), moves upward through (negative 1, 0) to (1, 1), moves upward to (2, 4), moves horizontally to the right and ends at (4, 4).](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/86ec94cda88d7637e7be738e7f2351771ef54048) ![Function h is graphed. The x-axis goes from negative 4 to 4. The graph consists of 2 sets of line segments. The first set starts at (negative 4, 0), moves upward to (negative 2, 2), moves downward and ends at an open circle at (negative 1, negative 1). The second set starts at a closed circle at (negative 1, 2), moves horizontally to the right to (1, 2), moves upward to (2, 4), moves downward and ends at (4, 2).](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/8681468c20ba5ae596e4c07636621767fff063bb)

**Find $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to -1}\dfrac{f(x)}{h(x)}$.**

[[☃ radio 1]]
